newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Europe central banks calm on US rate rise - Trichet.
newsitem.headline: Europe central banks calm on US rate rise - Trichet.

text.p: European central banks view last month's U.S. quarter-point rate rise with great calmness, Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Saturday.
"The (Bank of France) monetary policy council has maintained its rates at a very low level," he told a news conference after a meeting of European Union finance ministers here.
"Naturally the international environment has been changed. As regards the Bank of France, and other European central banks, we are very calm about this," he said.
He also said he personally saw no reason for market turbulence in the autumn of this year as European monetary union approached, saying the transparency of budget figures would prevent this.
